title: Why Jacky Chou says not to start an affiliate site in 2024 and what to do instead
summary: Jacky argues affiliate sites are unprofitable after Google's algo changes, which reward high domain authority over authentic content. He lays out a progression: short-term parasite SEO to get a first dollar, then rank and rent, client work, and finally partnerships. He also stresses daily consistency and building content around a hobby.

principles.text: Don't start an affiliate site in 2024; authentic content isn't rewarded because Google favors high domain authority sites.
principles.quote: the answer is hell no absolutely no not reason being it's just not profitable it's not it's not where you SN in your efforts and then you'll get rewarded for it

principles.text: Get your first dollar online via short-term parasite SEO; it shifts your belief about what's possible.
principles.quote: once you make that first dollar online it's just like I think something switches in your brain at least that was what happened for me

principles.text: Follow a progression: parasite SEO, then rank and rent, then client work, then partnerships.
principles.quote: I think you should move into Rank and rent then client work then Partnerships in the long term that should be like your route right now

principles.text: Dominate one local niche: rank for every suburb, take a client per neighborhood, then become the local SEO agency.
principles.quote: I'd become the physio guy in Vancouver I'd be the physio marketing guy in Vancouver I'd take one client from each neighborhood

principles.text: Local rank and rent can reach a few thousand per month and client work in one niche can exceed 10K to 20K.
principles.quote: I am absolutely confident you can get to probably 3 4K a month in rank and rents then with client work you can boost easily boost out up to over 10K I'd say even like 20K from local client work

principles.text: Consistency is the real moat: most people won't do a simple action daily for a year even if it replaces a salary.
principles.quote: if you posted a YouTube video every single day for a year that you could replace your full-time salary would you do it ... the drop off is incredible
